lanes.summary: FAIL: Commit dd433f11 ("ci: also move workspace-test to night") adds the night-only `if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` condition to the required `workspace-test` gate in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and adds a `|| id == "workspace-test"` exemption to `the_gates_still_run_on_every_pull_request_and_push` in `crates/xpile/tests/night_checks_off_pr_path.rs`. This directly violates PMAT-2170's title and acceptance criteria ("Seven ci.yml jobs (kani, lake-build, docs, wasi, lean-models, shader-validate, license-scan) ... gate and workspace-test unchanged"), contradicts the new comments in both `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `night_checks_off_pr_path.rs`, and disables a required merge-blocking gate on pull requests and pushes to `main`.

findings.claim: The REQUIRED merge-blocking job `workspace-test` is given `if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'`, removing it from the `pull_request` and `push` paths. This directly violates the PMAT-2170 title ("the seven non-blocking ci.yml jobs run only on schedule and workflow_dispatch"), the acceptance criteria in `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml:27414` ("Seven ci.yml jobs (kani, lake-build, docs, wasi, lean-models, shader-validate, license-scan) cannot block a merge; give each the job-level if: ... gate and workspace-test unchanged."), the `XPILE-ENFORCEMENT REQUIRED-CONTEXTS: gate, workspace-test` marker at line 113, and the prose comment added at lines 152-153 ("The REQUIRED jobs carry no job-level `if:` and need no night job").
findings.fix: Remove `if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` from the `workspace-test` job at line 161 so `workspace-test` remains unchanged.

findings.claim: `the_gates_still_run_on_every_pull_request_and_push` weakens its gate check via `j["if"].is_null() || id == "workspace-test"`, carving out a backdoor that permits the required `workspace-test` gate to carry a job-level `if:` condition and be skipped on PRs/pushes. This contradicts the module doc comment at lines 21-22 ("2. no required job carries a job-level `if:`, and the workflow still runs on `pull_request` and on `push` to `main`, so the gates are unchanged"), the assertion's own failure message ("required job `{id}` carries a job-level `if:` ... a gate that can be skipped is not a gate"), and the PMAT-2170 acceptance criteria ("gate and workspace-test unchanged").
findings.fix: Replace `j["if"].is_null() || id == "workspace-test",` with `j["if"].is_null(),` so no job in `REQUIRED_MARKER` may carry a job-level `if:`.

lanes.summary: The diff adds the night-only `if:` to `workspace-test`, which is a required merge-blocking gate. The ticket says "gate and workspace-test unchanged" and lists only seven jobs. The new test file also carves out a special case for `workspace-test`, so the test would not catch this. The seven advisory jobs are handled correctly. I did not run any build or test.

findings.claim: The diff adds `if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` to the `workspace-test` job. The ticket lists seven jobs (kani, lake-build, docs, wasi, lean-models, shader-validate, license-scan) and says 'gate and workspace-test unchanged'. Line 113 lists `workspace-test` as a REQUIRED context, so it is a merge-blocking gate. With this `if:` it is skipped on every pull_request and push, which turns a required gate off. It also contradicts the ci.yml comment the diff itself adds: 'The REQUIRED jobs carry no job-level `if:`'.
findings.fix: Remove the `if:` line from `workspace-test` in ci.yml and keep it on the seven advisory jobs only. Remove the `|| id == "workspace-test"` exemption from the test.

findings.claim: `the_gates_still_run_on_every_pull_request_and_push` asserts `j["if"].is_null() || id == "workspace-test"`. This exemption is written to let the forbidden `if:` on the required `workspace-test` job pass. The test therefore weakens its own gate and contradicts the ticket ('workspace-test unchanged'). The test's own message, 'a gate that can be skipped is not a gate', is contradicted by the exemption.
findings.fix: Require `j["if"].is_null()` for every required job, with no exemption.

findings.claim: The doc comment says the test asserts 'no required job carries a job-level `if:`', but the code exempts `workspace-test`. The comment claims more than the code checks.
